import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,shutil,subprocess
prefix='/opt/teaching-agent/roles-exporter/pg17.6-v1'
root=pathlib.Path('/build/output/runtime-rootfs')
def raw(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def elf(p):
    # Bound readelf parses bytes; never ldd/execute the input under inspection.
    dynamic=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/readelf','-d',str(p)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    program=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/readelf','-l',str(p)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    needed=re.findall(r'\(NEEDED\).*?\[([^]]+)\]',dynamic)
    interpreter=re.findall(r'Requesting program interpreter: ([^]\n]+)',program)
    return needed,interpreter
tools=[root/(prefix.lstrip('/')+'/bin/'+n) for n in ['pg_dumpall','pg_dump','receipt-launcher']]
shutil.copy2('/usr/bin/dash',root/'bin/sh')
libpq=root/(prefix.lstrip('/')+'/lib/libpq.so.5.17')
queue=tools+[root/'bin/sh',libpq]
# libpq belongs to the complete loader closure and remains in the traversal.
deps={'libpq.so.5':{'name':'libpq.so.5','path':prefix+'/lib/libpq.so.5','bytes':libpq.stat().st_size,'sha256':raw(libpq)}}; seen=set()
while queue:
    p=queue.pop()
    if str(p) in seen: continue
    seen.add(str(p)); needed,interpreters=elf(p)
    for interp in interpreters:
        if interp!='/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2': raise SystemExit('UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME_LOADER')
        src=pathlib.Path(interp).resolve(); dest=root/interp.lstrip('/')
        if 'ld-linux-x86-64.so.2' not in deps:
            shutil.copy2(src,dest); deps['ld-linux-x86-64.so.2']={'name':'ld-linux-x86-64.so.2','path':interp,'bytes':dest.stat().st_size,'sha256':raw(dest)};queue.append(dest)
    for name in needed:
        if '/' in name: raise SystemExit('UNSUPPORTED_NEEDED_PATH')
        if name in deps: continue
        src=pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')/name
        if not src.is_file(): raise SystemExit('UNBOUND_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY')
        dest=root/(prefix.lstrip('/')+'/lib/'+name); shutil.copy2(src.resolve(),dest)
        deps[name]={'name':name,'path':prefix+'/lib/'+name,'bytes':dest.stat().st_size,'sha256':raw(dest)}; queue.append(dest)
items=sorted(deps.values(),key=lambda x:x['name'].encode('ascii'))
if not 1<=len(items)<=64 or len({x['name'] for x in items})!=len(items): raise SystemExit('RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_DOMAIN')
# This is a staged candidate, not a BUILT lock or evidence of loadability.
# Actual loader closure (including dlopen/NSS/OpenSSL), versioned glibc/SSL
# symbols, base-image ABI and unchanged bytes require the later real checks.
pathlib.Path('/build/output/runtime-dependencies-candidate.json').write_text(json.dumps(items,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('STAGED_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ACTUAL_LOADER_ABI_AND_TLS_VALIDATION')
